title: ISO 21175-2 Collaborative Distributed Simulation Messages (Time Semantics Profile v2)
description: Versioned time-semantics profile for ISO 21175-2 JSON messages. This schema supports both common-time mode (all participants share compatible time semantics and conversion metadata may be omitted) and conversion-time mode (participants may differ and can include additional time semantics metadata).

MessageType.description: Controlled message type vocabulary defined by ISO 21175-2 Table 1.

Identifier.description: Identifier string. The standard recommends UUIDs, URIs, or other schemes with a low probability of collision. This schema does not impose a lexical identifier format. ErrorReport.simulationRunId may be an empty string when no simulation run can be linked to the error.

OptionalSimulationRunId.description: Simulation run identifier. For ErrorReport only, the standard requires this to be an empty string when no simulation run can be linked to the error.

LogicalTime.description: Logical simulation time value. Numeric values are permitted directly, and strings are permitted for exact decimal/integer encodings that must avoid floating-point precision loss.

TimeModeType.description: Runtime pacing strategy for simulation progression.

TimeDomain.description: Logical time domain used by a participant model.

TimeValueEncoding.description: Wire encoding for logical time values.

TimeConversionPolicy.description: Coordinator conversion strictness for cross-model logical-time mapping.

CoordinatorTimeConversionPolicy.description: Run-level coordinator policy for whether cross-model time conversion is active.

TimeRoundingMode.description: Rounding strategy used when approximate conversion is allowed.

TimeSemantics.description: Model-declared logical time semantics for interoperability checks and conversion.

unitSeconds.description: Rational number of SI seconds represented by one unit of model-local logical time.

quantum.description: Minimum model-local logical time increment. Required for discrete domains.

originOffset.description: Rational offset from model-local logical zero to coordinator-global logical zero.

TimeMode.description: Runtime pacing mode plus local-time semantics declaration for a model participant.

PrimitiveValue.description: Primitive or structured payload value. ISO 21175-2 permits boolean, int32/int64 as JSON integer numbers, float32/float64 as JSON numbers, string, objects, and arrays. The document also mentions bytes as Base64 strings in the JSON binding. Null is intentionally not included.

anyOf.description: Portable integer values should remain within the range exactly representable by IEEE 754 double precision: +/-9007199254740991. Wider integer values should be encoded as strings by agreement of all participants.

PrimitiveObject.description: Object built from primitive values, nested objects, and arrays. Used for structured payloads and state snapshots.

PrimitiveArray.description: Array containing primitive values, nested objects, and arrays.

NamedPrimitiveValues.description: JSON object whose properties are named primitive values defined by the standard or by the relevant port/message profile.

PortValue.description: Port-level value used in OutputReport.outputs and ExecuteTransition.inputs. The portName must identify a declared model port of the appropriate direction; this cannot be fully checked without the ISO 21175-3 model representation.

portName.description: Name of an input or output port, unique within the model scope.

value.description: Payload object containing one or more named primitive values.

CommonMessage.description: Common message envelope fields defined by ISO 21175-2 Table 2. Message-specific schemas add required fields and payload constraints.

simulationRunId.description: Identifier of the simulation run to which this message belongs. May be omitted only for errors not associated with a run in the abstract model; this schema's ErrorReport profile uses an empty string when no run can be linked, following the JSON binding text.

messageId.description: Message identifier unique within the scope of the simulation run.

senderId.description: Identifier of the sender within the simulation run, such as coordinator identifier, model identifier for a runner, or another participant.

receiverId.description: Identifier of the receiver within the simulation run, such as coordinator identifier, model identifier for a runner, or another participant.

correlationId.description: Optional identifier used to correlate related messages, for example a request/response pair.

timeMode.description: Optional participant time semantics metadata. Coordinators may require it when operating in conversion-time mode.

eventTime.description: Model-local logical time value. This is the first-class time for participant behavior.

globalEventTime.description: Optional coordinator-global logical time reference. Useful when coordinator and model local semantics differ.

nextInternalTime.description: Model-local next internal event time reported by the sender, when applicable.

payload.description: Message payload. The shape depends on messageType and, for port-level messages, on port definitions.

wallClockTime.description: Optional ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp for monitoring or logging. It does not affect simulation semantics.

allOf.title: SimulationInit
allOf.description: Coordinator-to-runner initialization. eventTime is model-local initial time. timeMode may be omitted in common-time mode and provided when conversion-time behavior is needed. timeConversionPolicy is optional and, when provided, applies to the full run.

allOf.title: SimulationTerminate
allOf.description: Coordinator-to-runner termination request. eventTime is model-local time and globalEventTime is coordinator-global reference time.

reason.description: Termination reason code or human-readable termination message.

allOf.title: ModelTerminated
allOf.description: Optional runner-to-coordinator acknowledgement that termination processing is complete.

allOf.title: NextInternalTimeReport
allOf.description: Runner-to-coordinator report of model-local next internal event time. timeMode may be included when coordinator performs conversion-time compatibility checks.

allOf.title: RequestOutput
allOf.description: Coordinator-to-runner request to evaluate output. eventTime is model-local dispatch time; globalEventTime is the coordinator-global reference time.

allOf.title: OutputReport
allOf.description: Runner-to-coordinator report of model outputs at model-local eventTime. The payload.outputs array carries zero or more output port values.

OutputReportPayload.description: OutputReport payload containing output port values. All outputs correspond to the enclosing message eventTime.

outputs.description: Zero or more output port values produced by the model's output function.

allOf.title: ExecuteTransition
allOf.description: Coordinator-to-runner request to execute transition logic. eventTime is model-local dispatch time; globalEventTime is coordinator-global reference time.

ExecuteTransitionPayload.description: Optional ExecuteTransition payload containing input port values. All inputs correspond to the enclosing message eventTime.

inputs.description: Zero or more input port values available to the model at eventTime.

allOf.title: TransitionComplete
allOf.description: Runner-to-coordinator acknowledgement that a requested transition completed at model-local eventTime, with model-local nextInternalTime.

allOf.title: MonitoringMessage
allOf.description: Optional monitoring, logging, or result reporting message. It observes the run without changing simulation state evolution.

MonitoringPayload.description: Monitoring payload. Category examples include stateSnapshot, metric, trace, debug, and runSummary.

category.description: Nature of the observation, such as stateSnapshot, metric, trace, debug, or runSummary.

values.description: Named primitive values whose interpretation depends on category.

sourceRole.description: Optional source role identifier. The standard names coordinator, runner, and another participant; exact casing is implementation-defined here.

allOf.title: ErrorReport
allOf.description: Error and diagnostic message. The JSON binding requires simulationRunId to be present and set to an empty string when no simulation run can be linked to the error.

ErrorReportPayload.description: ErrorReport payload containing origin, severity, code, and human-readable diagnostic message.

originRole.description: Role of the component that detected or originated the error.

originId.description: Identifier of the component that detected the error. Usually equal to senderId, but it may differ when an intermediary reports an error detected elsewhere.

severity.description: Severity level for the diagnostic condition.

errorCode.description: Error category according to an implementation-defined or community-defined registry. Clause 8 allows string or integer; the JSON binding text states integer. This schema accepts both to preserve compatibility with both statements.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the condition.
